correctness.rationale: The construction is computable because prime lengths are computable and the predicate “first halts at step t” is decidable by bounded simulation. A homomorphism between directed cycles of prime lengths forces the target length to equal the source length. The unary marker then makes each finite gadget map exactly when its indexed machine halts. The least-missing-number equivalence follows by enumerating all finite homomorphism witnesses in one direction and concatenating the halting gadgets in the other. The all-prefix predicate says that for every prefix there exists a finite homomorphism witness, hence \(\Pi^0_2\) on total computable presentations; the reduction from the totality problem for c.e. sets proves hardness.
